description: This file defines the MidiFramer class, which processes incoming MIDI byte streams and converts them into discrete MIDI messages, handling system exclusive messages, running status, and real-time messages.

classes.name: MidiFramer
classes.description: A subclass of MidiReceiver that parses a stream of MIDI bytes and sends complete MIDI messages to its receiver, implementing MIDI protocol parsing logic.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides the MidiReceiver.onSend method to process incoming MIDI data bytes, assemble complete MIDI messages, handle System Exclusive messages, and resolve running statuses.
